core_obligations: The separating map (proof lines 1169-1177): for a nonzero section over an open set the author uses the existence of a map from the submodule generated by the section into an injective module which does not annihilate it.

The extension and the conclusion (proof lines 1177-1179): the extension property of the injective module extends that map to the whole module, and evaluating the double dual at it gives a nonzero value on the original section, which proves injectivity.
proof_roadmap: Take a nonzero section and a map into an injective module not killing it.
Extend that map to the whole module by injectivity.
Evaluate to show that the section survives the evaluation map.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the evaluation map of a module into its double dual is injective (statement lines 1163-1167). The proof is a complete argument: a nonzero section is separated from zero by a map from the submodule it generates into an injective module (proof lines 1169-1177), that map extends to the whole module by the extension property of injective modules, and evaluating the double dual at the extension shows that the image of the section is nonzero, which is injectivity (proof lines 1177-1179). The non-formal content is the separation argument. The claim is H2.
